title: ashhart/TensorFold
lede: TensorFold is a Zig inference server that loads checkpoints, tokenizes and runs Metal or CUDA kernels itself, so serving a model on Apple Silicon or NVIDIA GPUs needs no Python or MLX.

points: One binary exposes OpenAI-style chat completions plus Responses and Anthropic Messages endpoints.
Ships through Homebrew on Macs and as checksummed Linux archives for x86_64 and aarch64, which need NVIDIA driver R580 or newer.
The --parallel flag caps concurrent requests and queues the rest; by default it asks for up to eight streams as memory allows.
The README lists per-model recipes, from Qwen3.5-2B on one Mac to GLM-5.3-Flash split across two or three GB10s.
Experimental Living Weights writes taught facts into a model's checkpoint files, with a rollback command, on Macs and the GB10.

points.text: Model coverage requests, such as native Metal support for the LFM3 checkpoints.
Qwen performance work on CUDA, including opt-in NVFP4 prefill and folding in pending kernel improvements.
A native Windows path, gated on a single-stream throughput target on an RTX 5090.
